During the opening statements before witnesses took the stand, Prosecutor Thane Rehn accused Sam Bankman-Fried of stealing billions from thousands of victims through Alameda Research and FTX, using Caroline Ellison as a front for secret access to customer funds. Rehn alleged that Bankman-Fried stole funds to finance jet-setting, donate millions to political candidates, and finance risky bets.

Defense lawyer Mark Cohen countered by arguing that Bankman-Fried acted in good faith as a nerdy startup founder and did not defraud anyone. Cohen characterized Alameda Research as a successful hedge fund and FTX as a very innovative, successful company rather than a Ponzi scheme. He stated that Alameda acted legally as an FTX customer, payment processor, and market maker. Cohen used the analogy that "working at a startup is like building a plane as you're flying it" and blamed Ellison for not adequately protecting the hedge fund from crypto market risks. Cohen concluded that Bankman-Fried started and built two billion-dollar businesses and did not steal any money.

The prosecution subsequently called witnesses Marc-Antoine Julliard and Adam Yedidia. Julliard is a Paris-born cocoa trader living in London who invested in crypto in 2021, chose FTX as his exchange, and traded Bitcoin and Dogecoin. Gary Wang is scheduled to testify next.

Sam Altman has backed a startup called Induced AI, founded this year by two teenagers. The company assists businesses in automating workflows by converting plain English back-office task instructions to pseudo-code in real time.

Google's annual hardware event showcased the Pixel 8, Pixel 8 Pro, Pixel Fold, Android 14, Pixel Buds, Google Assistant, Bard, and Pixel Watch 2. The Pixel 8 Pro features improved cameras, a brighter screen, and enhanced AI-powered features compared to the Pixel 7 Pro, though it includes an underutilized temperature sensor.

Dave Clark, former Amazon executive, was ousted as CEO of Flexport just a year into the job. Flexport is a freight forwarding and customs brokerage startup valued at $8 billion. Clark later criticized the company's founder and board following a CNBC report on his departure.

Sam Bankman-Fried is accused of orchestrating the collapse of cryptocurrency exchange FTX and is facing trial at the Manhattan Federal Court. Michael Lewis's book 'Going Infinite' details Sam Bankman-Fried's attempt to buy off Donald Trump to prevent him from running for president again. Jacquelyn and Alex reported on the SBF trial at the Southern District of New York courthouse, where Bankman-Fried faced charges of knowingly committing fraud for wealth and power.

LinkedIn launched AI tools for job hunting, marketing, and sales, including an updated Recruiter platform, an AI Learning coach, and a marketing campaign tool. Elon Musk stated X generated 100–200 million daily posts in September, while CEO Linda Yaccarino later claimed 500 million posts per day.

IronNet, founded in 2014 by former NSA director Keith Alexander, collapsed after going public in August 2021, laying off staff and seeing its stock price decline despite raising over $400 million. Esther Rodriguez-Villegas, a career academic, founded Acurable to create wearable devices that diagnose and manage respiratory conditions like sleep apnea and epilepsy at home. Breathe Battery Technologies created software for lithium-ion batteries to enable faster charging speeds or greater longevity. Anna surveyed 10 investors regarding the future of AI, covering startup opportunities, oligopoly dynamics, first-mover advantages, and the value of proprietary data.
